credits.title: GDL

credits.title: Without Blood
credits.overview: Nina, driven by revenge after losing her family during a devastating war, tracks down the man she believes holds the answers to their deaths.

credits.title: Emiliano's Mask
credits.overview: MEXICO, 1914. Amidst revolution, Emiliano Zapata seizes explosives from Ignacio de la Torre y Mier, his enemy's vain son-in-law, rekindling a past romance that transcends political divides.

credits.title: City of Dreams
credits.overview: A Mexican teenager whose dreams of becoming a soccer star are disrupted when his mother dies. He's smuggled across the border with the promise of a better life but is instead sold to a sweatshop in downtown LA.

credits.title: Black Moon
credits.overview: The story of three brothers arises between dreams, ideals and frustrations in the context of a community rebellion to defend their river from a construction company.

credits.title: Caballero Águila
credits.overview: After high school is over, three friends have to choose their paths. Pastor dreams of flying and winning Flor´s love, while her jealous brother Nacho gets seduced by the local gang, and falls in to crime.

credits.title: Drunken Birds
credits.overview: Willy's quest to find Marlena, his lost love, takes him from Mexico to Canada, where he is hired as a seasonal worker at the Bécotte farm, near Montreal. Several destinies intersect, worlds collide, tensions rise and moments of magical realism emerge during long work days.

credits.title: We Are Living Things
credits.overview: Two immigrants living on the fringes of American society hit the road in search of the truth about a shared UFO abduction.

credits.title: Roma
credits.overview: In 1970s Mexico City, two domestic workers help a mother of four while her husband is away for an extended period of time.
